submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 11 (Co 0.29 / V 0.71, between CoV3O8 and CoV2O6; MEGNet gap of CoV2O6 is about 2.3 eV) gave the highest photocurrent, 1.2e-6 A. The photocurrent peaks in the V-rich vanadate region.

rejected.reason: Measured 3e-8 A. The Co2V2O7-type region is about 40x worse.
Measured 8.6e-7 A. Moving further toward V lowers the photocurrent, so the peak is near Co 0.29.

consultations.verdict: MEGNet HSE gaps: CoV2O6 2.33, Co3V2O8 2.43, Co2V2O7 2.59 eV — all absorb the 3.22 eV illumination, so gap does not discriminate strongly; weakly favors Co2V2O7 region (largest gap, likely better band positions). Index 6 (Co 0.54) sits near Co2V2O7 and is a central probe of the line. Mildly supportive.

V2O5 gap 2.83 eV (absorbs at 3.22 eV). CoV5O15 predicted 0.73 eV, which is small-gap and likely poor. So the very V-rich region with mixed Co is uncertain. Index 11 (Co 0.29) lies between CoV3O8 and CoV2O6 (2.33 eV) and is a better probe than the Co 0.17 region. Mildly supportive.

MACE says CoV5O12 (Co 0.17) is near-hull (0.02 eV/atom), so a V-rich Co vanadate/V2O5 mixture is plausible around Co 0.17–0.2. Measured trend: more V is better (Co 0.54 gives 3e-8 A, Co 0.29 gives 1.2e-6 A). Index 2 (Co 0.196) continues toward the V-rich side and is also the GP-UCB pick. Supportive.
